name: GitHub
description: Surface PR review queue, notifications, assigned issues, starred repos, and per-repo stats in widgets via the GitHub REST API. A Personal Access Token is stored encrypted; widgets call iappyx.plugin('github').* without seeing it.
author: iappyx
aiPrompt: iappyx.plugin('github') wraps the GitHub REST API. User configures a Personal Access Token via Settings → Plugins → GitHub → Configure (no OAuth dance — PATs don't expire if you create them with no expiry). All methods return Promises; check {ok}. profile() → {ok, login, name, email, avatarUrl, publicRepos, followers, htmlUrl}. notifications({all:false, participating:false, top:25}) → {ok, items:[{id, repo, type:'PullRequest'|'Issue'|'Commit'|…, title, reason, updatedAt:ISO, url, unread}]}. pullRequestsToReview({top:25}) → {ok, items:[{repo, number, title, author, draft, mergeable, updatedAt:ISO, htmlUrl, additions, deletions, reviewers:[…]}]} — uses the search API with 'is:pr is:open review-requested:@me'. pullRequestsCreated({state:'open'|'closed'|'all', top:25}) → same shape but 'author:@me'. issuesAssigned({state:'open', top:25}) → {ok, items:[{repo, number, title, labels:[{name, color}], updatedAt:ISO, htmlUrl, state, comments}]}. starredRepos({top:25}) → {ok, items:[{owner, name, fullName, description, language, stars, forks, openIssues, updatedAt:ISO, htmlUrl, isArchived, isFork}]}. recentEvents({top:25}) → {ok, items:[{type, repo, actor, createdAt:ISO, public, payloadSummary}]} — chronological feed of the user's own public activity (commits, PRs, releases, comments). repoInfo({owner, repo}) → {ok, repo:{…}, latestRelease:{tagName, name, publishedAt, htmlUrl}|null}. repoTraffic({owner, repo}) → {ok, views:{count, uniques, days:[{timestamp, count, uniques}]}, clones:{count, uniques, days:[…]}} — requires push permission on the repo; falls back to {ok:false} otherwise. search({type:'repositories'|'issues'|'commits'|'code', q, top:25}) → raw search results in a normalised shape per type. All replies follow {ok:true, …} or {ok:false, error:'…'} — never throw. Best widgets: 'review queue' card showing PRs awaiting your review, 'contribution heatmap' from recentEvents, 'release feed' from starredRepos's latestRelease, 'stars trend' from repoTraffic. Best wallpapers: subtle accent reflecting GitHub contribution intensity (green-gradient overlay).
